_doc: Crescent Capital BDC A2 staged anchor proposal from the 2026-03-31 multi-quarter bundle. Bundle identifiers use Debt Investments, Equity Investments, Investment Type, Interest Term/rate phrases, Interest Rate, and Maturity/Dissolution Date. Exact-only GEO coverage handles country-only section rows in none_examples without changing full position signatures.

anchors.label: TOTAL
anchors.regex: ^\s*total\b|investments and cash equivalents total|cash equivalents total

anchors.label: CASH
anchors.regex: money market|government fund|u\.?s\.? government|treasury bill|liquidity (?:fund|funds)|cash and cash equivalent|cash equivalents

anchors.label: INVTYPE
anchors.regex: investment[^a-z0-9]+type|^\s*(?:senior secured|unitranche|subordinated|first lien|second lien|delayed draw|revolver|term loan)\b
